defects.summary: Raised by a human on Mike's instruction (2026-11-23). Three Developer unit tests in tests/tsqlt/test_MOD027_dev.sql fail in the MOD-028 regression run: 'rows_deleted counts the span trim and the in-window deletes together', 'an overflow in a later window keeps the committed window and logs Failed with its counts', 'counts add up across one-day windows and each window logs its synced cells'. Their silv_daily_count_detail and fact_daily_member_count_detail inserts predate the AMD-007 grain (RULE-155) and leave payment_method_id, payer_type_id and concession_type_id NULL in the faked tables.
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Run tSQLt test class test_MOD027_dev on the MOD-028 branch (TR-MOD-028-2).
defects.expected: All three pass, as before MOD-028: the Developer adds payment_method_id, payer_type_id and concession_type_id = 0 to every silv_daily_count_detail and fact_daily_member_count_detail row these tests insert (and to any expected rows or column lists), changing nothing else. The procedure code is not changed.
defects.actual: Each fails with 'Cannot insert the value NULL into column payment_method_id, table #det_stage' (error 515).
